editor_note: Entries 9-10 are faithful and natural. The heading uses "Primitivas", and the endianness contrast is kept exactly: BitArray defaults to `big`, Sampler/Estimator return big-endian, "mas o Executor retorna resultados little-endian", with the caveat rendered as "dependendo de a primitiva alterar ou não essa configuração".

All seven rewritten headings turn the English heading words into you-form commands: "Monitore, calibre e faça benchmark", "Monitore", "Monitore parâmetros", "Monitore de forma holística", "Calibre", "Faça benchmark". The page describes IBM's own internal processes, which entry 4 names as nouns ("monitoramento, calibração e benchmarking"). The commands make the headings read as tasks for the user, and "Calibre" on its own also reads as the noun "calibre" (gauge). The body text makes the real meaning clear, so a learner is not misled. A native editor would still use the matching nouns: "Monitoramento, calibração e benchmarking", "Monitoramento", "Monitoramento de parâmetros", "Monitoramento holístico", "Calibração", "Benchmarking".

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. Entry 27 ("Consulte a documentação da API do Samplomatic…") is accurate.

The 18 rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally, and the conditions and caveats are kept: "Talvez você não consiga mudar de região se, por exemplo", "reenvie para lá os jobs afetados" and "Recuperar e restaurar automaticamente" all match the English, and the casual "você" register holds throughout.

All 13 rewritten entries keep their meaning. The legacy server-side vs client-side contrast (24, 41), the v0.50.0 version notes (8, 23, 40), the roughly 32-qubit caution (42) and the measure_mitigation example (46) are all faithful, and none of them misleads. The fixes are about wording. "antes de comprometer tempo de QPU" (23, 40) is a calque of "committing QPU time", and since "comprometer" usually means "to compromise", a reader could take it the wrong way. "gastar/investir tempo de QPU" would be clearer. Entry 45 has "Simulação de Clifford", while the rest of the page uses "Simulação Clifford" (11, 35). "simulação básica" (42) for "base simulation" would read better as "simulação base".

editor_note: Entry [191] reverses the size of the main ZNE result. "worked quite a bit better than our attempt by hand" became "funcionou um pouco melhor" ("worked slightly better"), so learners take away the opposite of the lesson's point that the built-in ZNE is considerably better. Entry [12] overstates PEC as "a mais cara" (the most expensive) when the English says it is among the most expensive. Entry [164] garbles "two-qubit depth" into "profundidade de duas portas qubit". There are also consistency slips: ZNE is feminine ("a ZNE") through [201] and masculine ("o ZNE") from [261] on; both "twirling de Pauli" and "Pauli twirling" appear; and decimals switch between commas (0,959) and points (86.4%, 4.5%).

examples.source: We see that the built-in ZNE improved our estimate by over 15%, and worked quite a bit better than our attempt by hand.
examples.translation: Vemos que a ZNE embutida melhorou nossa estimativa em mais de 15% e funcionou um pouco melhor que nossa tentativa manual.
examples.suggested: Vemos que a ZNE embutida melhorou nossa estimativa em mais de 15% e funcionou bem melhor que nossa tentativa manual.
examples.why: 'quite a bit better' means considerably better; 'um pouco melhor' means slightly better. That shrinks the claim and undercuts the lesson's point that the built-in ZNE handles weighting much better.

examples.source: is among the most powerful, but also the most computationally expensive, error-mitigation techniques
examples.translation: é uma das técnicas de mitigação de erros mais poderosas, mas também a mais cara computacionalmente
examples.suggested: é uma das técnicas de mitigação de erros mais poderosas, mas também uma das mais caras computacionalmente
examples.why: The singular 'a mais cara' says PEC is the single most expensive technique, which is stronger than the English 'among the ...'.

examples.suggested: Por exemplo, na ZNE, supomos que o erro pode ser expandido

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. Entry 6 refers to the topic in the singular ("como ela funciona", where the English has "they"), which is fine, and entry 7's IBMVideo title ("visão geral das técnicas de supressão de erros quânticos, como elas funcionam e como se relacionam com outros métodos") matches the English.

All four rewritten titles are faithful and read naturally in Portuguese ("Química quântica com VQE", "Use um computador quântico hoje", "Qiskit na sala de aula - ciência da computação" / "- mecânica quântica"). The only difference is that they use sentence case while the older entries use Title Case, and sentence case is the more native Portuguese convention.

Both rewritten link titles are faithful and natural, and the rendering "Qiskit na sala de aula" is applied the same way in each, followed by "ciência da computação" in entry 2 and "mecânica quântica" in entry 3.

The meaning is faithful all the way through. Negations, inequalities, the variational-bound claims and the M_J and parity arguments in [29], [104], [170] and [176] all match the English, so nothing would mislead a learner. The problem is that terms change midway through the file. The method is "a SQD agrupada" up to about [81], then "o SQD pooled" from [157] on, which changes both the wording and the grammatical gender. The excitation pool is "conjunto" in the first half and "pool" from [128] on. editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, and nothing would mislead a learner. That includes the caveat-heavy diagonal-filter paragraph [58] and the advice on pruning versus recovery [91]. editor_note: All 60 rewritten entries carry the meaning faithfully. Negations, numbers and caveats survive intact, including the per-step-only reprocessing in [209], the no-energy-below −40.472331 MeV bound in [204] and the full Fortran/Python comparison table in [220]. "Bindings" changes gender between "os bindings" [170] and "as bindings" [198, 199]. "Excitation ensemble" is "ensemble de excitações" in [172], while "ensemble" is "conjunto" in [190, 209, 220]. examples.translation: Diagonalização quântica baseada em amostragem agrupada de um Hamiltoniano nuclear
examples.suggested: Diagonalização quântica agrupada baseada em amostragem de um Hamiltoniano nuclear
examples.why: The page title in [1] uses a different word order for the same English string. The two forms also attach "pooled" to different nouns.

examples.source: copies data/USDB.snt beside it
examples.translation: copia `data/USDB.snt` para o lado dele
examples.suggested: copia `data/USDB.snt` ao lado dele
examples.why: "Para o lado dele" reads as a direction ("toward his side"). The idiomatic phrase for the location is "ao lado dele".

editor_note: All three rewritten entries (18, 65, 71) keep the English meaning. Nothing is inverted, dropped or added: the v0.47.0 version, "supressão e mitigação de erros", the anti-noise injection "no caso do PEC" and the canonical_qubits reasoning are all intact. Two small style points. In entry 18 the link text for the internal guide stays as lowercase English mid-sentence ("Leia mais no guia [directed execution model]"), but the page translates other internal guide titles ("padrões do Qiskit", "Combinar opções de mitigação de erros..."). Entry 71 has a calque, "como resultado de como a ordem dos qubits é capturada", that a native editor would smooth.

examples.source: Read more in the [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model) guide.
examples.translation: Leia mais no guia [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model).
examples.suggested: Leia mais no guia [modelo de execução direcionada](/guides/directed-execution-model).
examples.why: This lowercase English phrase reads oddly mid-sentence, and it doesn't match how the page translates other internal guide link titles.

examples.source: as a result of how qubit order is captured when boxing circuits and finding unique instructions
examples.translation: como resultado de como a ordem dos qubits é capturada ao colocar circuitos em boxes e encontrar instruções únicas
examples.suggested: devido à forma como a ordem dos qubits é capturada ao colocar circuitos em boxes e identificar instruções únicas
examples.why: "como resultado de como" copies the English sentence structure and reads stiffly. "devido à forma como" is the natural Portuguese phrasing.

editor_note: Entry 126 is faithful and reads naturally. It renders "map these Pauli terms to the canonical form expected by the Executor" as "mapear esses termos de Pauli para a forma canônica esperada pelo `Executor`" and "canonical qubit ordering" as "ordenação canônica de qubits", both consistent with the rest of the page.

Nothing here would mislead a learner. The hard parts all come through intact: the caveat that random sampling performs about as well as QAOA ([21], [55]), the post-selection explanation ([36]), the "not beaten on every objective at once" Pareto definition ([42]) and the brute-force disclaimer ([43]). The terminology is consistent throughout: fronteira de Pareto, mixer XY, pós-seleção, estado de produto de matrizes (MPS), portas de dois qubits. Two English metaphors are carried over word for word where a Portuguese technical writer would rephrase: "pesos ... que vivem em um simplex" in [19] and "o mesmo orçamento de portas compra um circuito mais raso" in [50].

examples.source: weights $c$ that live on a simplex (they sum to one)
examples.translation: pesos $c$ que vivem em um simplex (somam um)
examples.suggested: pesos $c$ que pertencem a um simplex (somam um)
examples.why: 'Live on' is an English mathematical idiom. 'Vivem em' is a literal carry-over; 'pertencem a' or 'estão definidos sobre' is the usual phrasing in Portuguese.

examples.source: so the same gate budget buys a shallower, more hardware-friendly circuit
examples.translation: de modo que o mesmo orçamento de portas compra um circuito mais raso e mais adequado ao hardware
examples.suggested: de modo que, com o mesmo orçamento de portas, se obtém um circuito mais raso e mais adequado ao hardware
examples.why: 'Orçamento ... compra' carries over the English 'budget buys' metaphor word for word and sounds stiff in Portuguese technical prose.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. I found no drift in the sample-complexity claims, the postselection logic ([76], [83], [87]) or the scaling statements ([40], [72]). The problem is terms that are not used consistently. The method is kept as "shadow tomography" in [0]–[43], then becomes the hybrid "tomografia de shadow" in [72], [75] and [86]. "primitive Sampler" in [63] turns into "primitiva Sampler" in [82]. "simulação de vetor de estado" in [59] and [65] turns into "statevector" in [75]. "códigos espaço-temporais" in [8] and [12] turns into "códigos de espaço-tempo" in [76] and [90]. "Backend" is capitalized in the middle of a sentence in [80].

examples.source: The shot scaling of shadow tomography is assessed
examples.translation: O escalonamento de shots da tomografia de shadow é avaliado
examples.suggested: O escalonamento de shots da shadow tomography é avaliado
examples.why: Entries [0]–[43] keep the established term "shadow tomography"; the hybrid "tomografia de shadow" here (and in [75], [86]) splits the term within the file.

examples.source: This mirrors what the Sampler primitive does on hardware
examples.translation: Isso espelha o que a primitive Sampler faz no hardware
examples.suggested: Isso espelha o que a primitiva Sampler faz no hardware
examples.why: Mixes the English "primitive" with a feminine article. [82] uses "primitiva Sampler".

examples.translation: em um statevector sem ruído
examples.suggested: em um vetor de estado sem ruído
examples.why: [59] and [65] translate it as "vetor de estado", so this is inconsistent.

examples.translation: detecção de erros de baixo overhead com códigos de espaço-tempo
examples.suggested: detecção de erros de baixo overhead com códigos espaço-temporais
examples.why: [8] and [12] use "códigos espaço-temporais". Pick one form.

examples.translation: caracteriza o ruído do Backend
examples.suggested: caracteriza o ruído do backend

editor_note: None of the 86 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The numbers (1137 of 10000 shots, 49 of 120 α-determinants, 0.1373 Ha), the caveats in [169]/[170] and the C++/Python comparison table [164] all match the English. The heading [123] "ordenar normalmente o Hamiltoniano" reads as "order it normally" instead of "put it in normal order". "bitstrings" changes gender: the rewritten C++ entries use masculine ("os bitstrings" [138][143], "Descartados/Reparados" [164]), while the Python tab uses feminine ("as bitstrings"). "in place" is rendered as "*no próprio lugar*" in [128] but left as "*in place*" in [64]. Smaller points: "volta como exatamente 1.0" [128] is a calque, and "no IBM Quantum Platform" [116] should be "na", to match "a IBM Cloud Platform" in [113].

examples.source: Create and normal-order the Hamiltonian
examples.translation: Criar e ordenar normalmente o Hamiltoniano
examples.suggested: Criar o Hamiltoniano e colocá-lo em ordem normal
examples.why: 'ordenar normalmente' reads as 'order in the usual way'. The technical concept is 'ordem normal', which the page uses correctly in [56] and [64].

examples.source: collects the bitstrings from `result[0]`
examples.translation: coleta os bitstrings de `result[0]`
examples.suggested: coleta as bitstrings de `result[0]`
examples.why: The rewritten C++ entries ([138], [143], [164]) make 'bitstrings' masculine, but the Python tab ([88], [97], [98]) makes it feminine. This is an inconsistency within the file.

examples.source: Normalization rescales every coefficient to unit magnitude *in place* ... every $|c_j|$ reads back as exactly `1.0`
examples.translation: redimensiona todos os coeficientes para magnitude unitária *no próprio lugar* ... todo $|c_j|$ volta como exatamente `1.0`
examples.suggested: redimensiona todos os coeficientes para magnitude unitária *in place* (sobrescrevendo-os) ... todo $|c_j|$ passa a valer exatamente `1.0`
examples.why: 'no próprio lugar' is a literal calque, and [64] keeps 'in place' in English. 'volta como' copies 'reads back as' word for word.

examples.source: Get your API key from [IBM Quantum Platform]
examples.translation: Obtenha sua chave de API no [IBM Quantum Platform]
examples.suggested: Obtenha sua chave de API na [IBM Quantum Platform]
examples.why: Platform is feminine, and [113] already says 'a IBM Cloud Platform'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the trade-off argument in [63]/[67] (finer, finest, Trotter error versus gate noise) and the caveat in [64] that the reference is itself approximate. Nothing here would mislead a learner. There are three small polish issues. "Transverse-field" is rendered as both "campo transverso" ([0], [1], [10], [15]) and "campo transversal" ([36], [62]). [20] has the uncontracted "em esta issue aberta" where it should read "nesta". "Trotterized" also alternates between "evolução trotterizada" ([15]) and "circuitos com Trotterização" ([40], [41], [46], [67]).

examples.source: described by the transverse-field Ising model above
examples.translation: descrita pelo modelo de Ising de campo transversal acima
examples.suggested: descrita pelo modelo de Ising de campo transverso acima
examples.why: The title and entries [1], [10] and [15] use "campo transverso". Use one rendering throughout the file, and change [62] ("campo transversal") to match.

examples.source: (tracked in [this open issue](...))
examples.translation: (acompanhado em [esta issue aberta](...))
examples.suggested: (acompanhado [nesta issue aberta](...))
examples.why: Portuguese requires the contraction em + esta = nesta. "em esta" reads as an error.

examples.source: results obtained from the Trotterized circuits
examples.translation: resultados obtidos dos circuitos com Trotterização
examples.suggested: resultados obtidos dos circuitos trotterizados
examples.why: [15] uses the adjective "trotterizada". Elsewhere the file switches to the wordier "com Trotterização", so pick one form.
